name: Myers Power Products
old_description: Reliability, Dependability, Flexibility...Trust in the Power of Myers!
about:
Myers Power Products operates division headquarters and manufacturing in Ontario, California, and corporate headquarters in Ohio, with a third site planned in Tatamy, Pennsylvania. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The company engineers, manufactures, and tests electrical power distribution equipment, including medium-voltage switchgear up to 15 kV, low-voltage switchgear, switchboards, panelboards, power distribution centers, circuit breakers, pedestals, UPS and inverter systems, and DC power solutions for rail and transit. Production spans nearly 1 million square feet across five states, employing more than 1,000 workers. A recent project for the Tyee Substation rebuild in Lakewood, Washington, involved a 34-by-15-foot NEMA 3R enclosure housing 15 kV metal-clad switchgear, protection relays, and a SCADA interface, all built and tested at the Ontario factory.

Myers serves transit agencies, electric utilities, and industrial customers. Its AC circuit breakers have seen hundreds of installations in transit, utility, and industrial settings. The Tyee Substation project was completed for a public power association in the Pacific Northwest.

Myers emphasizes domestic production, stating its products are made or assembled in the United States. The company positions itself on engineered-to-order flexibility and proven technology with built-in flexibility.
